notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26500126/82f7d3af0adc13cfd302fa70794500269256c463.jpg[/img]
Hello fellows! Here is our new update.

What is new:
[list]
    [*] Camera distance improved.
    [*] Progress clearing fixed.
    [*] Screws counter bug fixed.
    [*] Achievement "motivation" is fixed.
    [*] Shadow for Canny in the sewers added. 
    [*] Cutscenes can be skipped with esc/start button. 
[/list]

We are still have some issues to work at. New update will be available soon. If you face some new problems let us know.
Enjoy the game! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26500126/6fc07230c9b1a2bdd5dc197451a6d9ff64284032.jpg[/img]Hello guys! We are really sorry that our release version was a little bit buggy! So thanks for your patience and your feedback. We have fixed the most annoying issues, that you have mentioned in reports.

What is fixed:
[list]
[*]Terminal (Robot Commander) interface bug fixed (you can now go back to the game with esc button).
[*]Falling trough the floor bug fixed.
[*]Screws collected on the first scene (house) are staying now.
[*]Some achievements are fixed.
[/list]

We are still here to support the game, so if you face some new bugs, don't hesitate to write us about it. 
Enjoy the game! ːsteamhappyː
